_comment: Source of truth for the research map. `col`/`row` are grid coordinates (deterministic layout, no physics). Regenerate the SVG with: python3 build_research_map.py

nodes.label: ML-Accelerated Metadynamics
nodes.tip: Enhanced sampling on a machine-learned surrogate at reference accuracy.

nodes.label: MACE ↔ xTB Validation
nodes.tip: Pillar 1 — does the surrogate reproduce the reference at equilibrium?

nodes.label: Reactive Chemistry
nodes.tip: Pillar 2 — does that agreement survive bond forming?

nodes.label: Post-training Correction
nodes.tip: Pillar 3 — can a lightweight correction close the gap?

nodes.label: Adaptive / Iterative Sampling
nodes.tip: Pillar 4 — does iterating the correction keep improving it?

nodes.label: Study 05 · MACE-OFF23 validation
nodes.tip: Force parity r ≈ 0.99, 2–3 meV/atom, cost crossover by n ≈ 50.

nodes.label: MD structure & throughput
nodes.tip: Identical O–O peak at 2.83 Å; ~37 ms/step, on par with xTB.

nodes.label: Study 03 · Large vacuum droplets
nodes.tip: Size suppresses evaporation; n = 20–50 droplets stay intact.

nodes.label: Study 06 · kpush scaling
nodes.tip: Bias force ∝ kpush/N, so kpush must scale ∝ N.

nodes.label: Study 07 · Collective-variable scoping
nodes.tip: Seven candidate CVs collapse to about three independent axes.

nodes.label: Studies 01–02 · early bias sweeps
nodes.tip: The RMSD bias breaks the weakest bond; periodicity confines the system.

nodes.label: Study 04 · Diels–Alder benchmark
nodes.tip: Verified concerted TS: 6.7 kcal/mol, 2.32 Å, −394 cm⁻¹.

nodes.label: Reaction energetics · scan / NEB / Sella
nodes.tip: xTB 6.7 vs raw MACE ~36 kcal/mol; MACE is method-invariant.

nodes.label: Barrier-region error localization
nodes.tip: Force error rises ~2.5–2.9× and cosine drops to 0.950 at the TS.

nodes.label: Identical-geometry test
nodes.tip: On the same frozen geometries: xTB 6.7 vs MACE 27.9 kcal/mol.

nodes.label: Cross-PES saddle validation
nodes.tip: MACE saddle at 2.004 Å / 35.8 kcal/mol; δx perturbations all recover it.

nodes.label: Study 08 · Post-training corrections
nodes.tip: Global, affine, element, and conservative pairwise Delta.

nodes.label: Conservative pairwise Delta
nodes.tip: Radial pair potentials, forces = −∇ΔE; MD-safe, no retraining.

nodes.label: Targeted vs generic calibration
nodes.tip: Equal budget: barrier data 14.1 → 9.9; generic data 14.1 → 15.0.

nodes.label: Certified saddle · 6.33 kcal/mol
nodes.tip: Same model, proper saddle search: 6.33 vs the xTB target of 6.7.

nodes.label: Iterative loop · negative result
nodes.tip: 42 further xTB calls; iteration 0 stays best, later ones oscillate.

nodes.label: Capacity ablation (open)
nodes.tip: Hold the acquisition rule fixed, vary correction expressiveness.

nodes.label: Acquisition metric (open)
nodes.tip: Only worth building if capacity is shown not to be the bottleneck.
